verdict.rationale: Reflect ships a built-in AI palette, opened with cmd+j on highlighted text. It offers a dozen or so preset prompts (e.g. 'list action-items', 'list key takeaways'), free-form requests, saved custom prompts, a choice of GPT-4o or Claude 3.5 Sonnet, and 'chat' with filtered notes to ask questions. However, all of it is documented as prompt-driven text transformation and Q&A on selected text or notes, not as delegating tasks the assistant carries out across the app. Missing for 10: evidence the assistant takes actions in the product (creating or editing notes, multi-step task execution), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI features.
